response.sql: WITH equip_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equip_avg), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, e.avg_humidity - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM equip_avg e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS kept_avg FROM kept), ranked AS (SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.excess_over_overall, ABS(k.avg_humidity - m.kept_avg) AS dist_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m), top_ranked AS (SELECT r.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.dist_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM ranked r) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, excess_over_overall, dist_from_kept_mean FROM top_ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY dist_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST;

assumptions.assumption: Each equipment's average is AVG(humepct) over its scanenvironment rows, with NULL humidity readings excluded; equipment with no readings has no average and is left out of the overall average.
The all-equipment average is the unweighted mean of the per-equipment averages, so each equipment counts once regardless of how many readings it has.
'How far it is from the mean of the kept equipment' is the absolute difference, ABS(avg - kept mean).
If the overall average or the kept mean is NULL (no readings, or no equipment above the average), the filters yield no rows, so the query returns nothing.
Ranking uses RANK() on the distance, descending with NULLs last, and keeps rank <= 10, so rows tied with the 10th are included.
